alreadyObserved: The analyst read the official 2024 paper, Zenodo record, experiment metadata workbook, and archive member names.
The paper reports aggregate beginning-of-life statistics and states that RPT8 is the last reference test shared by all 40 cells; these published aggregates were visible before sealing.
No per-cell Performance Summary or Ageing Sets Summary CSV content was read before sealing.
A separate 116-cell Panasonic dataset was screened and rejected for this cycle because its 70%-of-initial-capacity-or-project-end endpoint is censored and not aligned with RC52 cycle-life labels.
notYetObservedAtSeal: No per-cell RPT0 or RPT8 capacity, resistance, electrode-capacity, offset, degradation-mode, or throughput value had been read.
No pilot, development, or target response had been computed.
No three-arm model had been fitted and no prediction error, rank correlation, or arm comparison had been computed.
No feature, ridge penalty, split, threshold, or decision rule had been changed in response to a per-cell result.

selection.reason: RC52 showed that twenty-cycle electrical features do not transport reliably across four battery sources. The fifth source must therefore test a missing bridge rather than add another flexible predictor. The Imperial LG M50T study supplies 40 cells, 15 operating conditions, a common RPT8 endpoint, beginning-of-life GITT resistance, and electrode-resolved degradation-mode analysis. This makes it possible to ask whether an orthogonal electrochemical passport improves prediction under held-out usage regimes.
selection.claimBoundary: RC53 is a mechanism-bridge experiment. It does not validate remaining useful life, an end-of-life distribution, field-pack safety, chemistry transfer, or a universal digital twin because the source stopped some cells before a common end-of-life threshold.
selection.deferredScope: Cyber-trust experiments, destructive post-mortem work, new cell cycling, field packs, warranty decisions, and safety certification remain outside scope.

sourceManifest.cellType: LG M50T 21700, NMC811 positive electrode and graphite/silicon-oxide composite negative electrode
sourceManifest.remoteAccess: Read only central directories and registered summary CSV members through HTTP range requests. Do not download or repackage the 49.4 GB raw archive.

cohortRule: Include every cell listed in the official experiment_metadata.xlsx workbook.
Require a matching Performance Summary CSV and an RPT0 and RPT8 row with finite C/10 capacity.
Do not remove a cell because a feature is extreme or an error is large.
If a registered passport field is absent for an entire source arm, report that arm as not computable; do not silently substitute an outcome-derived feature.

pilot.selection: Two cells per development experiment, selected by ascending SHA-256 of 'rc53-pilot:<experiment>-<cell>'.
pilot.use: Schema, units, row identity, and sign checks only. Pilot rows have zero weight in every fitted model and every reported error metric.
pilot.permittedAmendment: Before any other CSV is read, a dated amendment may map exact column names to the already registered quantities or declare a quantity unavailable. It may not change the split, response, features, model, thresholds, or hypotheses.

untouchedTarget.reason: The target holds out complete SoC/protocol regimes: 70-85% cycling, drive-cycle discharge, and standard 0-100% cycling. No target row is used for preprocessing, fitting, feature selection, or threshold selection.

responseContract.name: capacity_retention_rpt8
responseContract.definition: C/10 discharge capacity at RPT8 divided by C/10 discharge capacity at RPT0 for the same cell.
responseContract.whyRPT8: The primary paper identifies RPT8 as the last RPT completed by all 40 cells. This creates a common, uncensored diagnostic horizon without pretending that every cell reached a shared EOL.
responseContract.unit: fraction; errors are reported in percentage points
responseContract.prohibitedInterpretation: Do not call this cycle life, remaining useful life, time to 80%, time to 70%, or field service life.

capacityArm.meaning: Usage conditions plus conventional beginning-of-life cell capacity.

passportArm.meaning: Usage and capacity plus the RPT0 electrode-capacity/offset fit and GITT resistance at the registered twelfth pulse near 52% SoC.

featureContract.preprocessing: For each arm, subtract the 14-row development mean and divide by the development population standard deviation; replace exactly zero standard deviation with one. The pilot and target do not contribute to these values.
featureContract.missingness: No outcome-aware imputation. A missing registered input makes that arm non-computable for the affected cell; report exact denominators.

modelContract.regressor: Ridge regression with an unpenalized intercept and fixed L2 alpha 1.0, fitted separately for arms A, B, and C on the 14 development cells.
modelContract.implementation: Solve the centered normal equations (X'X + I) beta = X'y using deterministic Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting. No library optimizer, hyperparameter search, feature selection, clipping, or target transformation.
primaryMetrics: Target median absolute error in percentage points for each arm.
Target mean absolute error and maximum absolute error in percentage points for each arm.
Spearman rank correlation between prediction and observed RPT8 retention for each arm.
Median absolute error separately for held-out experiments 2,2, 4, and 5.
modelContract.comparisons: Report C relative to A and C relative to B as (baseline MdAE - C MdAE) / baseline MdAE. Report all arms even when a gate fails.
modelContract.independentAdjudication: A dependency-free Node implementation recomputes preprocessing, ridge coefficients, all 22 target predictions, metrics, and verdicts from the derived feature table. Absolute numeric disagreement above 1e-8 fails the cycle.

competingHypotheses.claim: Known temperature and SoC/protocol descriptors are sufficient to predict the common-horizon degradation response in unseen usage regimes.
competingHypotheses.prediction: Arm A target MdAE is at most 1.5 percentage points, Spearman rho is at least 0.60, and every held-out experiment has MdAE at most 2.0 percentage points.

competingHypotheses.claim: Conventional BoL capacity contains transferable cell-level information beyond imposed stress.
competingHypotheses.prediction: Arm B reduces target MdAE by at least 10% relative to A without increasing maximum absolute error.

competingHypotheses.claim: The BoL electrode/resistance passport supplies a transportable bridge to the later degradation response.
competingHypotheses.prediction: Arm C has target MdAE at most 1.25 percentage points, reduces MdAE by at least 20% relative to A and at least 10% relative to B, has Spearman rho at least 0.60, and has no held-out-experiment MdAE above 2.0 percentage points.
competingHypotheses.reject: Reject if any boundary fails; a lower pooled error alone is insufficient.

competingHypotheses.claim: A common RPT8 capacity response establishes a fifth-source lifetime or EOL validation for RC52.
competingHypotheses.prediction: The dataset would need a common EOL event and an untouched EOL adjudication cohort, which it does not provide.
competingHypotheses.reject: Mark unsupported by design regardless of predictive accuracy.

hardGates: The official record contains 40 metadata rows and exactly one registered Performance Summary CSV per row.
Only archive directories, not summary values, were inspected before this precommit.
Pilot cells are used only for schema and unit validation and have zero model influence.
No non-pilot summary value is read before the pilot amendment is sealed.
The response remains RPT8 C/10 capacity divided by RPT0 C/10 capacity.
All 22 target cells remain untouched until column mapping, feature order, ridge alpha, and code paths are frozen.
Preprocessing uses only the 14 development rows.
All three arms use the same development and target rows.
No target-aware feature selection, imputation, clipping, recalibration, or model tuning is allowed.
Every target prediction and all three held-out experiment summaries are reported.
Python and dependency-free Node results agree within 1e-8.
RPT8 retention is not represented as lifetime, EOL, safety, warranty, or field performance.
Failed hypotheses, missing fields, extraction failures, and the fifth-source EOL non-result remain in the public research record.
causalChain: Imposed temperature and SoC/protocol plus BoL capacity, electrode-fit, and GITT resistance measurements
unobserved initial susceptibility and usage-dependent degradation pathway
a frozen orthogonal diagnostic passport that must add signal outside the development regimes
independent RPT8 capacity retention for 22 cells in three unseen regimes
retain or reject the passport as a candidate measurement for a later common-EOL lifetime experiment

uncertaintyBudget.control: Use source-provided processed summaries and fixed RPT0/RPT8 rows; preserve units and exact column names in the pilot amendment.
uncertaintyBudget.stop: A unit or row identity that cannot be resolved without looking at target responses stops the affected arm.

uncertaintyBudget.control: Freeze three nested feature sets and ridge alpha 1.0 before outcomes; reproduce independently in Node.
uncertaintyBudget.stop: Numeric disagreement above 1e-8 or a singular implementation error blocks interpretation.

uncertaintyBudget.control: Hold out complete experiments and report 22 cell predictions plus per-experiment errors.
uncertaintyBudget.stop: Do not generalize beyond LG M50T or the five tested experiment families.

uncertaintyBudget.control: Use the last common uncensored RPT rather than a fabricated EOL label.
uncertaintyBudget.stop: No lifetime claim is permitted from RPT8 retention.

uncertaintyBudget.control: Treat DMA and GITT quantities as electrochemical diagnostic proxies, not direct destructive observations of SEI, plating, or cracking.
uncertaintyBudget.stop: Prediction improvement alone does not identify a unique degradation mechanism.

safetyEthics: RC53 uses public, previously collected electrochemical data. It performs no charging, fabrication, cell opening, personal-data processing, or security-sensitive experiment. Its output is research evidence, not an operational safety decision.
